final: WITH team_sums AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(g - w) as team_sum FROM manager WHERE g IS NOT NULL AND w IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(team_sum) as total FROM team_sums WHERE team_sum IS NOT NULL), average_team_sum AS (SELECT AVG(team_sum) as avg_sum FROM team_sums WHERE team_sum IS NOT NULL), team_with_share AS (SELECT ts.team_id, ts.team_sum, ot.total, CAST(ts.team_sum AS FLOAT) / CAST(ot.total AS FLOAT) as share FROM team_sums ts, overall_total ot WHERE ts.team_sum IS NOT NULL AND ot.total IS NOT NULL), kept_teams AS (SELECT tws.team_id, tws.team_sum, tws.share, ats.avg_sum FROM team_with_share tws CROSS JOIN average_team_sum ats WHERE tws.team_sum > ats.avg_sum) SELECT AVG(team_sum) as avg_kept_sum, AVG(share) as avg_kept_share, AVG(team_sum - avg_sum) as avg_diff_from_overall_avg FROM kept_teams
